描述_EN: the 'creeper' is instantly recognisable to fans of the game. the ‘creeper’ is a hostile character encountered in the minecraft world. minecraft was created by swedish games designer markus ‘notch’ persson. the sprite has become the most recognisable and marketable character, and is usually seen as the mascot of the series. the minecraft online community has been noted by observers as one which is cohesive and mutually supportive. it attacks the player by creeping up on them, then exploding. this hooded sweatshirt, halfway between casual clothing and fancy dress, designed for a boy aged 13-14, shows succinctly how this video game has entered the consciousness of the western teenage world, and how the 'creeper' character has been adopted by many young people as a mark of affiliation. at its most basic, it is a first-person, open-world sandbox game, in which players build constructions out of textured cubes.
描述_ZN: "爬行者 "对于游戏的粉丝来说是一眼就能认出的。 "爬行者 "是在Minecraft世界中遇到的一个敌对角色。 Minecraft是由瑞典游戏设计师Markus 'notch' Persson创造的。 该精灵已成为最易识别和最有市场的角色，并且通常被视为该系列的吉祥物。 观察家们注意到，Minecraft在线社区是一个具有凝聚力和相互支持的社区。 它通过爬上玩家，然后爆炸来攻击他们。 这件连帽运动衫，介于休闲服装和奇装异服之间，为13-14岁的男孩设计，简洁地显示了这个视频游戏是如何进入西方青少年世界的意识，以及 "爬行者 "角色是如何被许多年轻人作为一种归属的标志。 最基本的是，它是一个第一人称的开放世界沙盒游戏，玩家在其中用有纹理的立方体建造建筑。
